_readme: Hand-maintained decision ledger, companion to AUTHORIZATION.md. NOT touched by any build script (contrast with data/generated/authorization-candidates.json, which is overwritten every `npm run build`/`npm run dev`). AGENTS.md is the sole legal/editorial authorization record; data/authorizations.toml is its build-checked structured mirror; this file adds decision-state (authorized / declined / pending + tier) on top of the raw candidate feed in reports/authorization-candidates.md. If this file and AGENTS.md ever disagree, AGENTS.md wins. Nothing in this file grants an authorization by itself.

current_feed_stats.note: Feed size only — NOT a triage. The two 2026-08-05 subjects were authorized by the owner directly, not from a triage round; a fresh triage of the grown feed is an open task.

declined.subject: Radovan Krejčíř
declined.reason: No public office, no institutional angle — a true-crime profile of a private convicted individual fails the constitution's public-interest test (§7). May appear only as a context entity where already-cited reporting documents a relation to an authorized subject.
declined.agents_md_section: Not authorized: Radovan Krejčíř (on the record)

Authorized for two topics: (1) GMR GAS s.r.o. ownership + tie to GMR GAS UA LLC — written, sourced, live; (2) donations to Klub motoristů, z.s. — authorized scope but no source found, tracked as GAP-01 rather than written unsourced or silently dropped.

tier_c_bare_registry_stub_not_recommende.note: AGROFERT statutory-board member, zero claims/sources/relations. Discovered via ares-expansion-26185610-2026-07-31.

not_eligible_context_only.note: Only persons can become dossier subjects under this site's data model. These remain context entities regardless of how much reporting cites them, unless the site ever adds an institutional/company dossier type (not proposed here).

process: Owner states scope explicitly, on the record, in conversation — who, which topics, sourced to what was actually opened and read.
scripts/dossier/authorize-entity.mjs writes the new entry (interactive, human-typed scope text — the only thing allowed to do this).
A new dated subsection is appended to AGENTS.md's append-only log.
A matching [[authorizations]] entry is added to data/authorizations.toml.
This file and AUTHORIZATION.md are updated by hand to move the row from pending to authorized/declined.
npm run scaffold:dossier only after the AGENTS.md entry exists.
